editorial:
Imagine walking into a job thinking you are going to save the world, only to find out you are working for the bad guys. That is exactly what happens to Dr. Jason in this gritty old-school drama. He is a sweet, naive guy who takes a job at a school for rebellious girls. At first, he thinks he can just be nice to the students to help them change. However, he quickly finds out that the women running the place are actually cruel and treat the girls terribly. You will really feel for Loretta, the tough girl who eventually tells him the truth about the horror happening behind closed doors.

What makes this movie work is the tension as Jason realizes he is in over his head. The acting is solid for its time, and the pacing keeps you interested as he hunts for proof of the abuse. While some parts feel a bit dated, the message about standing up for what is right still hits home. If you enjoy stories about underdogs fighting a corrupt system, you should definitely check this out. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or search for a restored version to add to your 4K Blu-ray collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Jason finally gets the hard evidence he needs to prove the matrons are abusing the girls. Instead of just calling the police, he uses the proof to blackmail the head of the school. He tells the boss that he will expose the truth unless he is put in charge of the entire facility. The boss agrees, and Jason gets the power to change the rules and treat the girls with kindness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old movies about fighting corruption and helping others.
